title: Topological line arrangements with high multiplicities
summary: We investigate constraints on the existence of topological and smooth realisations of combinatorial line arrangements and $(n_k)$-configurations in the complex projective plane. By replacing complex lines with locally-flatly or smoothly embedded 2-spheres, we explore the extent to which classical geometric results, such as Hirzebruch's inequality, persist in the topological or smooth category. We introduce two classes of special line arrangements that we call odd and even. We provide constraints for any smoothly realised, non-trivial, odd arrangement via Furuta's 10/8-Theorem.
